content.comment_body: Hi, is there a way to connect more than one (I need 3) [product_name] text displays to a single [product_name] controller?
Hi, that's not possible—unless you manually switch datalines, but then only one text display will work at any moment.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about connecting multiple [product_name] text displays to a single [product_name] controller. The answer clarified that only one display can be active at a time, and using more than one simultaneously is not supported, which limits solutions for those needing multiple interfaces.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] controller to allow the simultaneous operation and connection of several text displays.
